questions.question: Which of the following is a supervised learning algorithm?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A decision tree learns from labeled data, so it is supervised. K-means is unsupervised clustering, and reinforcement learning is a separate paradigm based on rewards.

questions.question: What is the use of ios::trunc mode?

options.A: To open a file in input mode
options.B: To open a file in output mode
options.C: To truncate an existing file to zero
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: ios::trunc discards the existing contents of a file, truncating it to zero length when it is opened. ios::in and ios::out are the input and output modes.

questions.question: Wireless transmission of signals can be done via

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: Radio waves, microwaves and infrared are all unguided (wireless) media, so more than one option is correct.

questions.question: BLE stands for

options.D: Bluetooth long energy

questions.explanation: BLE is Bluetooth Low Energy, a low-power Bluetooth variant widely used in IoT. The other expansions are invented.

questions.question: Which programming language is often used for server-side web development?

options.D: PHP

questions.explanation: PHP runs on the web server to generate dynamic pages. HTML and CSS are markup/styling languages, and JavaScript is traditionally client-side.

questions.question: A compiler is a translating program which

options.A: translates instruction of a high-level language into machine language
options.B: translates entire source program into machine language program
options.C: is not involved in program's execution
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A compiler translates high-level instructions into machine language, translates the entire source program at once, and is not needed while the compiled program executes. Since A, B and C all hold, the answer is 'More than one of the above'.

questions.question: The hexadecimal number F4 is equivalent to which binary number?
questions.explanation: Each hex digit maps to 4 bits: F = 1111 and 4 = 0100, so F4 = 11110100.

questions.question: You can edit an embedded organization chart object by

options.A: Double clicking the organization chart object
options.C: Right clicking the chart object, then clicking edit MS-Organization Chart object
options.D: both (A) and (C)

questions.explanation: An embedded organization chart can be opened for editing either by double-clicking it or by right-clicking and choosing Edit MS-Organization Chart Object, so both (A) and (C).

questions.question: What is the main advantage of using abstract classes over interfaces?

options.A: Abstract classes can have multiple inheritance, unlike interfaces
options.B: Interfaces can have constructors, while abstract classes cannot
options.C: Abstract classes can provide default implementations of methods
options.D: Interfaces allow for private access modifiers, unlike abstract classes

questions.explanation: Abstract classes can contain concrete methods with default implementations (plus state and constructors). Classes cannot multiply-inherit abstract classes, and interfaces have no constructors, so A and B are false.

questions.question: What is another name for the circular queue among the following options?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A circular queue is also called a ring buffer because the last position connects back to the first.

questions.question: What is a page in paging?

options.A: A fixed-size block of virtual memory
options.B: A fixed-size block of physical memory
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A page is a fixed-size block of the logical (virtual) address space. A fixed-size block of physical memory is called a frame.

questions.question: Where will the Hill Climbing Algorithm terminate?

options.D: All of the above

questions.explanation: Hill climbing stops when no neighbouring state has a higher value than the current one, which may be only a local maximum. It does not guarantee reaching the global maximum.

questions.question: What is the default format of date in MySQL?

options.D: YYYY-DD-MM

questions.explanation: MySQL stores and displays DATE values in the ISO format 'YYYY-MM-DD'. Formats like DD-MM-YYYY are regional display conventions, not the MySQL default.

questions.question: Transmission control protocol

options.B: uses a three-way handshake to establish a connection
options.C: receives data from application as a single stream
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: TCP is connection-oriented, establishes connections using a three-way handshake, and receives data from the application as a byte stream. All of A, B and C are true.

questions.question: Which of the following is NOT a component of a Turing machine?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A standard Turing machine has an infinite tape (used for input and output), a read/write head and a finite control unit. There is no separate output tape.

questions.question: To preview a motion path effect using the custom animation task pane, we should

options.D: None of these

questions.explanation: In the Custom Animation task pane, clicking the Play button previews the selected animation effects, including motion paths.

questions.question: Which of the following constructors is provided by the C++ compiler if not defined in a class?

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: If not user-declared, the compiler implicitly provides a default constructor and a copy constructor. A parameterized constructor is never generated, so more than one of A-C (A and B) is correct.

questions.question: Sniffers can be prevented by using

options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A switched network sends frames only to the destination port, unlike hubs that broadcast to all, making passive sniffing much harder. A wired or shared Ethernet LAN alone does not prevent sniffing.

questions.question: Multimedia systems require hard real-time scheduling ________

options.A: to ensure critical tasks will be serviced within timing deadlines
options.B: to deliver the media file to the client
options.D: for security

questions.explanation: Continuous media must be processed within strict deadlines, so hard real-time scheduling is used to guarantee that critical tasks are serviced within their timing deadlines. Merely minimizing delay is not a guarantee.

questions.question: A problem is said to be in NP if:

options.A: Its solution can be verified in polynomial time
options.B: It can be solved using a non-deterministic algorithm
options.D: It has exponential complexity

questions.explanation: NP is the class of decision problems whose proposed solution (certificate) can be verified in polynomial time. Exponential complexity or being unsolvable does not define NP.

questions.question: When does a negative level triggered flip-flop in Digital Electronics changes its state?

options.C: When the inputs are all zero
options.D: More than one of the above

questions.explanation: A negative (low) level triggered flip-flop responds to its inputs and can change state while the clock is at its low (negative) level. A positive level is the condition for a positive level triggered device.

questions.question: _____ attribute is used to specify the location of an image file.

options.D: name

questions.explanation: The src attribute of gives the path/URL of the image file. alt only provides alternate text.

questions.question: The basic operations performed by a computer are

options.D: All of these

questions.explanation: A computer performs arithmetic operations, logical operations and stores/relates data, so all of these are basic operations.

questions.question: What is the purpose of staffing level estimation in software project management?

options.A: To determine the number of hardware components required
options.B: To identify potential risks in the project
options.C: To allocate appropriate resources to the project
options.D: To estimate the maintenance costs of the software

questions.explanation: Staffing level estimation decides how many people are needed in each phase, so that appropriate human resources can be allocated (e.g. using the Rayleigh-Norden curve).
